en: Historic black‑and‑white/sepia postcard view of a cobblestone street lined with two‑story buildings and shops. On the left is a corner building with signs, one reading "Cigarren" and another "Otto Krause". People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the sidewalk and a small cart stands in the street. A row of trees and a railing run along the right side beside the street, with a tall utility pole visible. Printed text at the top identifies the scene as Schliebenenstraße in Herzberg (Elster).
